h: Peter Obi demands release of supporter reportedly arrested in Lagos
p: Peter Obi has called for the release of a supporter, Rilwan Olawale, who was reportedly arrested in Lagos. Obi urged the authorities to free him without delay. No official reason for the arrest has been made public.
more: Obi's supporters have taken the call to social media.
Police have not yet commented publicly.
